title: Generative AI for Hate Speech Detection: Evaluation and Findings

bias_targets.target: Hate speech and Toxicity (encompassing racial, nationality, religious, and sexual orientation biases)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, F1) on binary hate speech classification across multiple social media datasets, including the evaluation of implicit hate speech against minority groups using datasets like ToxiGen.

Using a cross-dataset (4-vs-1) transfer learning evaluation setup to measure how well models generalize to unseen data distributions and whether synthetic data augmentation helps them overcome dataset-specific keyword memorization.
